prompt: Please turn each photo I upload into an independent "Rubber Stamp Travel Field Notes Poster," outputting each photo separately without multi-image collage. The overall layout uses a 4:3 horizontal composition, dividing the screen into left and right areas, but without drawing obvious dividing lines. The left side occupies about 58% of the frame, faithfully preserving the original photo. Accurately maintain the identity of the subject, terrain, buildings, plants, people, spatial relationships, natural lighting, real textures, and original color atmosphere, applying only restrained art-publication-level photographic color grading and adding extremely slight fine film grain. Natural cropping is allowed to fit the layout, but do not stretch, distort, move, replace, or redraw the subject. The right side occupies about 42%, using warm off-white old paper as a background. The paper has subtle fibers, natural grains, slight signs of use, and a matte feel, while retaining large areas of unprinted paper white space, making the void an important part of the layout. Analyze the original photo to extract the most recognizable subject outlines, architectural structures, terrain trends, plant postures, roads, shorelines, or other key visual relationships, compressing them into a small multi-color rubber stamp image. Do not copy everything from the photo item by item. Retain only the minimum information necessary for someone to recognize the original location, subject, and scene relationships at a glance. Delete crowds, vehicles, dense windows, repetitive buildings, fine vegetation, decorative components, and irrelevant backgrounds. The stamp is located in the lower-middle part of the right paper area, occupying only about 30%-38% of the height of the right area, with sufficient white space reserved around it. The stamp cannot be enlarged into a common illustration, full landscape painting, or brand logo. Decide the organization of the stamp based on the original image's composition: - Iconic buildings: Keep the most recognizable outer outlines, roofs, domes, arches, towers, or main structures. - Mountain settlements: Compress buildings into a few stepped color blocks arranged along the terrain. - Coastal scenery: Keep the mountain trends, settlement levels, shorelines, and a few intermittent water ripples. - Urban vistas: Keep the main skyline, one landmark building, and one or two layers of distant mountains. - Natural landscapes: Keep the main mountain bodies, trees, shores, or road directional relationships. - Foreground obstructions: If important to the original narrative, keep them as foreground stamp outlines. Extract 2-4 spot ink colors from the original photo. Prioritize desaturated colors like carbon black, dark green, brick red, ochre yellow, grey-blue, and grey-brown, but do not force a fixed palette. Retain the most recognizable color character of the original photo, allowing only a small area of color for visual emphasis. Each color should appear as if individually hand-stamped: authentic rubber stamp carving textures, hand-cut marks, uneven hatching, outline gaps, broken edges, dry ink shortage, paper transparency, grainy ink, uneven pressure, partial ghosting, and a slight color registration offset of about 1-2 mm. Natural misalignment between different color layers is allowed; edges should not be digitally smooth. The imprint should look like a rubber stamp truly carved and pressed onto old paper, not a filtered photo, smooth vector illustration, or line-art logo. Generate text based on the location, theme, and visual imagery in the photo: Location name in English, No. serial number, three short English keywords, AD year. promptZh: 请将我上传的每张照片转换为独立的“橡胶印章旅行田野笔记海报”，每张照片单独输出，不要进行多图拼接。整体布局采用 4:3 横向构图，将画面分为左右两部分，但不绘制明显的分割线。左侧占据约 58% 的画面，忠实保留原始照片。准确维持主体、地形、建筑、植物、人物、空间关系、自然光影、真实质感及原始色彩氛围，仅应用克制的艺术出版级照片调色，并添加极细微的胶片颗粒感。允许为适配布局进行自然裁剪，但不得拉伸、扭曲、移动、替换或重绘主体。右侧占据约 42%，使用暖色调灰白色旧纸张作为背景。纸张具有细腻的纤维、自然纹理、轻微的使用痕迹和哑光质感，同时保留大面积未印刷的留白，使空白成为布局的重要组成部分。分析原始照片，提取最具辨识度的主体轮廓、建筑结构、地形走势、植物姿态、道路、海岸线或其他关键视觉关系，将其压缩为小型多色橡胶印章图像。不要逐项复制照片中的所有内容，仅保留让观众一眼识别原始地点、主体和场景关系所需的最小信息量。删除人群、车辆、密集的窗户、重复的建筑、细碎的植被、装饰性构件及无关背景。印章位于右侧纸张区域的中下部，仅占据右侧区域高度的约 30%-38%，周围留有充足的留白。印章不得放大为普通的插画、全景画或品牌 Logo。根据原始图像的构图决定印章的组织方式：- 标志性建筑：保留最具辨识度的外轮廓、屋顶、圆顶、拱门、塔楼或主体结构。- 山地聚落：将建筑压缩为沿地形排列的几个阶梯状色块。- 海岸风光：保留山势、聚落层次、海岸线及少量间歇性的水波纹。- 城市景观：保留主要天际线、一座地标建筑以及一两层远山。- 自然景观：保留主要山体、树木、岸线或道路指向关系。- 前景遮挡：若对原始叙事重要，将其保留为前景印章轮廓。从原始照片中提取 2-4 种专色墨水颜色。优先选择碳黑、深绿、砖红、赭黄、灰蓝和灰褐等低饱和度颜色，但不要强行固定调色板。保留原始照片最具辨识度的色彩特征，仅允许小面积色彩作为视觉强调。每种颜色应呈现出仿佛手工逐一盖印的效果：真实的橡胶印章雕刻质感、手工切割痕迹、不均匀的阴影线、轮廓缺口、边缘破损、墨水干涸感、纸张透明度、颗粒感墨水、压力不均、局部重影以及约 1-2 毫米的轻微套色偏移。允许不同色层之间存在自然的错位；边缘不应呈现数字化的平滑感。印记应看起来像是真正雕刻并盖在旧纸上的橡胶印章，而非滤镜照片、平滑的矢量插画或线条 Logo。根据照片中的地点、主题和视觉意象生成文字：英文地点名称、No. 序列号、三个简短的英文关键词、AD 年份。将文字放置在印章下方或相邻的留白处，使用小巧、克制、略带...
